facts: The byte-identical H02 worker artifacts were integrated after accepted H01 and passed 195 tests with the existing native journal and approval invariants.

The coordinator-host run used the normal macOS tempfile identity and passed the /var/folders alias regression that the worker's forced managed TMPDIR could only exercise through an equivalent topology.
summary: H02 composes with accepted H01, the native journal and approval invariants on the coordinator host.
